text.tspan: ESWCap C+R Meter — carrier board Rev C.1
Sheet 1 — System overview, modes and amplifier list
Team Praise Claude · Embedded Systems Workshop · 2026-11-14 · Sheet 1/7
Power, relay drivers, console, J8 header, full pin map: sheet 6 · complete KiCad schematic (every wire): sheet 7
Measurement modes (set by firmware through PB9 → K1, PB10 → K2)
Power-off / reset state = C-mode (both relays de-energised: FL grounded, C_BLOCK connected).
Every amplifier / comparator in the design
TIA: converts the nA DUT current to a voltage (R16 10 MΩ)
Unity buffer for SL (DUT sense-low) → VBUF
Kelvin current loop: drives Q1 so MUXR_COM = VREF (0.405 V)
V_SH buffer; Kelvin: PGA ×2…×64 referenced to VBUF
COMP1 threshold 1.65 V / COMP4 threshold 2.6 V
TLC2272 / TLC2262 are not used: they need ≥ 4.4 V and the carrier runs on 3.3 V.
Firmware note: OPAMP3 PGA mode, PC4 (U10), PB15 (MUXR_EN) and PB2 (VBUF) follow docs/accuracy-plan.md F1–F3 (firmware update pending).
blue text = net name (identical to the KiCad schematic)
green dashed box = inside the STM32; ◦ PAx (J2-n) = MCU pin (WeAct header pin)
small numbers next to a part = its pin numbers
